verdicts.summary:
Lean has an equivalent formula. Lines 1, 3 and 4 are stated as declarations up to the repository's class encoding. A class bound (MemClass / LocalJets, WeightedClasses.lean:89-110) says: for every order m there are C and p with ‖D^j f_n(x)‖ ≤ C ε_n^β (S_n · max 1 δ(x)⁻¹)^p · w for all j ≤ m, uniformly in band and point. The paper's two exponents S_*^{b_I} δ^{-M_I} become one common power of growth (separate_powers_le_growth, WeightedClasses.lean:65, records the conversion); the weight is ζ for line 1 (weights_jets / inverse_class, with weights = H⁻¹R by SmoothCovariance.inverse_formula), √ζ for line 3 (increment_jets / signed_quotient_class), √ζ·W for line 4 (signedVector_jets / signedVector_class), and β = α-1 gives ε^{α-1}, ε^{α-1}, ε^{α-1/2}. The NativeCovariance hypotheses are met by the construction (ActualSignedStageControls.nativeCovariance :816, covariance_at_label :1185), and the actual-chart line 4 is actual_raw_coefficients_jets (:1159) at exponent α-1/2 with the request at α-1.

Line 2 (the a_σ⁻¹ bound) is not stated as its own declaration at a_σ: rescaled_rpow_jet_bound is used in the repository only at p = 1/2 (sqrt_jet_bound, WeightedQuotients.lean:227), and the Lean bounds the quotient r/(2√g) in one step. It does follow from stated declarations by instantiation: a_σ = √(weights H T j) (SmoothCovariance.amplitudes, PartitionedCovariance.amplitudes_are_inverse_weights), so a_σ⁻¹ = g^(-1/2) with g = weights; local_input_envelope (or SignedCovariance.class_input_envelope) gives B = C·growth^p with ζ/B ≤ g and ‖D^j g‖ ≤ ζ·B from the stated jets and the stated lower bound c·ζ ≤ g; normalized_bounds and neg_half_power_bound give the two zeroth-order hypotheses; rescaled_rpow_jet_bound at p = -1/2, w = ζ(x) then reads ‖D^n(g^(-1/2))‖ ≤ ζ^(-1/2)·(n!·coeffBound)·(C·growth^p)^(2n+1), which is line 2. The same bound in normalized form is the proof step hPj at SignedCopyBounds.lean:259 (and WeightedQuotients.lean:324). I did not find this instantiation written out anywhere; it is my own combination of the declarations named. On the cell-level (LocalJets) path smoothness is only ContDiffAt, so the instantiation goes through rpow_comp_jets_at (SignedCopyBounds.lean:192) plus the constant rescaling rather than rescaled_rpow_jet_bound literally; on the strip-level (MemClass) path rescaled_rpow_jet_bound applies directly. I did not check that a CovarianceControl instance exists for the actual construction; the NativeCovariance one does.
